summary: Task 6 cleanly migrates the frontend trigger contract to the FunnelTrigger[] array model and adds a well-structured, well-tested FunnelTriggersPanel. Types, store pass-through, keyword-hint scan, i18n parity and all 50 affected tests (incl. the new 7-test panel spec) pass; locale parity check exits 0. No critical or major issues; the editor page's stale flat-trigger usage is explicitly Task 7 scope and breaks no automated gate (no typecheck/CI), so it is tracked as an observation rather than a finding.

suggestions.suggestion: The on_start 'main entry' section mounts FunnelTriggerSettings, which exposes the full 5-type selector (on_start/keyword/tag_added/custom_field_set/event). The author can therefore change the main entry's type away from on_start, contradicting the file-level comment that on_start 'is never deletable from this panel' and potentially leaving the funnel with zero on_start element. Consider pinning the main-entry row to triggerType=on_start (hide/disable the type select for this slot, e.g. a `lockType` / `hideTypeSelect` prop on FunnelTriggerSettings) or guarding onTypeChange(onStartIndex, ...) to ignore non-on_start values.
suggestions.benefit: Prevents the author from accidentally removing the funnel's main entry from the UI; aligns runtime behaviour with the component's documented invariant. Server-side ≤1 on_start is enforced (Task 4) but a missing on_start is not clearly rejected, so the client guard avoids a confusing state.

suggestions.suggestion: modelToEntry(ENTRY_START) returns firstStepId.value, which is null when the funnel has no saved step yet; addEvent() then creates an event trigger with entryStepId=null. Per Decision 14 the backend requires a non-null entryStepId for event, so this row will 422 on save. The component relies on the server backstop + advisory, which is acceptable per spec, but consider surfacing an inline advisory when an event row resolves to a null entry (no saved steps) so the author understands the save will be rejected before hitting the server.
suggestions.benefit: Closes the loop between the 'mid-entry is event-only / requires a step' rule and the author's mental model when the funnel has no persisted step, reducing surprise 422s. Purely advisory — does not gate save.

suggestions.suggestion: OBSERVATION (explicitly Task 7 scope, not a Task 6 defect): the editor page still reads res.triggerType/res.triggerValue/res.keywords and sends triggerType/triggerValue/keywords in UpdateFunnelRequest — fields removed from FunnelResponse/UpdateFunnelRequest by this task. This is a type-level mismatch only; it compiles at runtime (esbuild strips types) and its 46 tests pass. There is no typecheck script and no CI workflow under .github/workflows, so no automated gate fails. Ensure Task 7 migrates this page to mount FunnelTriggersPanel and use the triggers array; until then a `vue-tsc` run would report errors here.
suggestions.benefit: Documents the known deferred breakage so it is not lost; confirms it is contained to one file and gated only by Task 7, not by Task 6 acceptance.

suggestions.suggestion: addEvent() sets selectedIndex.value = props.triggers.length optimistically, but the panel is prop-driven (parent owns the array via update:triggers) so the row at that index only exists after the parent re-passes the prop. The optimistic selection is harmless today, but if the parent debounces/rejects the update the highlight points at a non-existent row. Consider deriving selection from the emitted array length or letting the parent confirm before highlighting.
suggestions.benefit: Avoids a transient selected-index pointing past the rendered rows in the (Task 7) autosave/parent-controlled flow.
